overview.zh: AK10-9 V2.0 KV100 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK10-9 V2.0 KV100 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：48 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：960 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：18 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：205/421 rpm
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 48 Nm; Weight (g): 960 g; Rated voltage (V): 24/48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 18 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 205/421 rpm

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK10-9 V2.0 KV60 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK10-9 V2.0 KV60 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：48 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：960 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：18 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：109/228 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：430 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 48 Nm; Weight (g): 960 g; Rated voltage (V): 24/48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 18 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 109/228 rpm; Rated Power (W): 430 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK10-9 V3.0 KV60 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK10-9 V3.0 KV60 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage (v)：48 v；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (Nm)：18 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed (rpm)：235 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (Nm)：53 Nm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：442 W；质量 · Weight (G)：940 g
overview.en: Rated Voltage (v): 48 v; Rated Torque (Nm): 18 Nm; Rated Speed (rpm): 235 rpm; Peak Torque (Nm): 53 Nm; Rated Power (W): 442 W; Weight (G): 940 g

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK40-10 KV170 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK40-10 KV170 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：4.1 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：1.3 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：370 rpm；质量 · Weight (g)：185 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：59 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 4.1 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 24 V; Rated torque (Nm): 1.3 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 370 rpm; Weight (g): 185 g; Rated Power (W): 59 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK40-10 V3.0 KV170 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK40-10 V3.0 KV170 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：190 g；通信接口 · Communication Method：CAN；额定功率 · Rated Power V：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：1.3 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：4.1 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：370 RPM
overview.en: Weight g: 190 g; Communication Method: CAN; Rated Power V: 24 V; Rated Torque N·m: 1.3 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 4.1 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 370 RPM

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK45-10 KV75 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK45-10 KV75 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：7 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：2.5 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：150 rpm；质量 · Weight (g)：260 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：39 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 7 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 24 V; Rated torque (Nm): 2.5 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 150 rpm; Weight (g): 260 g; Rated Power (W): 39 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK45-10 V3.0 KV75 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK45-10 V3.0 KV75 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：262 g；通信接口 · Communication Method：CAN；额定功率 · Rated Power V：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：2.5 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：7 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：120 RPM
overview.en: Weight g: 262 g; Communication Method: CAN; Rated Power V: 24 V; Rated Torque N·m: 2.5 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 7 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 120 RPM

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK45-36 V3.0 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK45-36 V3.0 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK45-36 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK45-36 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：24 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：8 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：40 rpm；质量 · Weight (g)：340 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：33 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 24 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 24 V; Rated torque (Nm): 8 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 40 rpm; Weight (g): 340 g; Rated Power (W): 33 W

integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK60-39 V3.0 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK60-39 V3.0 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：72 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：24 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：70 rpm；质量 · Weight (g)：750 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：176 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 72 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 24 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 70 rpm; Weight (g): 750 g; Rated Power (W): 176 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK60-6 V3.0 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK60-6 V3.0 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage (v)：24/48 v；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (Nm)：3 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed (rpm)：233/490 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：60/125 W；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (Nm)：9 Nm；质量 · Weight (G)：380 g
overview.en: Rated Voltage (v): 24/48 v; Rated Torque (Nm): 3 Nm; Rated Speed (rpm): 233/490 rpm; Rated Power (W): 60/125 W; Peak Torque (Nm): 9 Nm; Weight (G): 380 g

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK70-10 KV100 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK70-10 KV100 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：24.8 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：621 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：8.3 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：148/310 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：230 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 24.8 Nm; Weight (g): 621 g; Rated voltage (V): 24/48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 8.3 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 148/310 rpm; Rated Power (W): 230 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK70-9 V3.0 KV60 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK70-9 V3.0 KV60 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (N·m)：29.2 N·m；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (N·m)：8.5 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed (RPM)：260 RPM；质量 · Weight (g)：540 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：231 W
overview.en: Peak Torque (N·m): 29.2 N·m; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V; Rated Torque (N·m): 8.5 N·m; Rated Speed (RPM): 260 RPM; Weight (g): 540 g; Rated Power (W): 231 W

overview.zh: AK80-64 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK80-64 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：120 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：850 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：48 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：23/48 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：220 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 120 Nm; Weight (g): 850 g; Rated voltage (V): 24/48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 48 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 23/48 rpm; Rated Power (W): 220 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

overview.zh: AK80-8 KV60 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK80-8 KV60 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：25 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：570 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：10 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：243 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：230 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 25 Nm; Weight (g): 570 g; Rated voltage (V): 48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 10 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 243 rpm; Rated Power (W): 230 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK80-9 V3.0 KV100 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AK80-9 V3.0 KV100 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：22 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：9 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：390 rpm；质量 · Weight (g)：490 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：368 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 22 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 9 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 390 rpm; Weight (g): 490 g; Rated Power (W): 368 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AKE60-8 KV80 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AKE60-8 KV80 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：12.5 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：5 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：260 g；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：180 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：95 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 12.5 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 24 V; Rated torque (Nm): 5 Nm; Weight (g): 260 g; Rated speed (rpm): 180 rpm; Rated Power (W): 95 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AKE80-8 KV30 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AKE80-8 KV30 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：30 Nm；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：12 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：570 g；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：150 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：188 W
overview.en: Peak torque (Nm): 30 Nm; Rated voltage (V): 48 V; Rated torque (Nm): 12 Nm; Weight (g): 570 g; Rated speed (rpm): 150 rpm; Rated Power (W): 188 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AKE90-8 KV35 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AKE90-8 KV35 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight (g)：1400 g；额定电压 · Rated voltage (V)：48 V；峰值扭矩 · Peak torque (Nm)：170 Nm；额定扭矩 · Rated torque (Nm)：55 Nm；额定转速 · Rated speed (rpm)：120 rpm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：700 W
overview.en: Weight (g): 1400 g; Rated voltage (V): 48 V; Peak torque (Nm): 170 Nm; Rated torque (Nm): 55 Nm; Rated speed (rpm): 120 rpm; Rated Power (W): 700 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AKH70-16 V1.0 KV41 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AKH70-16 V1.0 KV41 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (N·m)：78 N·m；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (N·m)：26 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed (RPM)：90 RPM；质量 · Weight (g)：879 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：245 W
overview.en: Peak Torque (N·m): 78 N·m; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V; Rated Torque (N·m): 26 N·m; Rated Speed (RPM): 90 RPM; Weight (g): 879 g; Rated Power (W): 245 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AKH70-48 V1.0 KV41 是 CubeMars 的机器人关节执行器，用于机器人关节的转矩、速度和位置控制。结构与接口按具体代际和型号区分，带减速器的模块不能用裸电机常数直接代替输出端额定值。
overview.en: AKH70-48 V1.0 KV41 is a CubeMars robotic joint actuator for robot-joint torque, speed and position control. Construction and interfaces vary by generation and model; bare-motor constants do not replace geared-output ratings.

overview.zh: 峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (N·m)：222 N·m；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (N·m)：74 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed (RPM)：28 RPM；质量 · Weight (g)：1396 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：217 W
overview.en: Peak Torque (N·m): 222 N·m; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V; Rated Torque (N·m): 74 N·m; Rated Speed (RPM): 28 RPM; Weight (g): 1396 g; Rated Power (W): 217 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK40-2410-1A-A1 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK40-2410-1A-A1 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK54-4810-1C-A2 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK54-4810-1C-A2 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

overview.zh: AK60-4820-1C-A2 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK60-4820-1C-A2 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK60-4820-2D-A2 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK60-4820-2D-A2 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK70-4820-2D-A3 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK70-4820-2D-A3 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK80-4830-1C-A4 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: AK80-4830-1C-A4 provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.en: GL80 KV30 belongs to CubeMars' gimbal motor range. The manufacturer lists Gimbal, Radar among its applications.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque (Nm)：1 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed (rpm)：450 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque (Nm)：2.9 Nm；质量 · Weight (g)：315 g；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：48 W
overview.en: Rated Voltage (V): 24 V; Rated Torque (Nm): 1 Nm; Rated Speed (rpm): 450 rpm; Peak Torque (Nm): 2.9 Nm; Weight (g): 315 g; Rated Power (W): 48 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI100 KV105 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI100 KV105 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage（V）：24/36/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque（Nm）：1.76 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed（rpm）：1370/2100/2825 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque（Nm）：4.95 Nm；质量 · Weight（g）：500 g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24/36/48 V
overview.en: Rated Voltage（V）: 24/36/48 V; Rated Torque（Nm）: 1.76 Nm; Rated Speed（rpm）: 1370/2100/2825 rpm; Peak Torque（Nm）: 4.95 Nm; Weight（g）: 500 g; Rated Voltage (V): 24/36/48 V

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI115-PH KV40 Welded Model 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI115-PH KV40 Welded Model is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：411 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：5.5 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：16 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：1430 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 411 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 5.5 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 16 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 1430 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI115-PH KV40 With Connector 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI115-PH KV40 With Connector is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：411 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：5.5 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：16 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：1430 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 411 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 5.5 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 16 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 1430 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI20 KV600 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI20 KV600 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：20g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：16 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：0.024 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：0.072 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：7452 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：16 V
overview.en: Weight g: 20g; Rated Power V: 16 V; Rated Torque N·m: 0.024 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 0.072 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 7452 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 16 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI30 KV260 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI30 KV260 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：40g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：0.076 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：0.23 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：4110 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24 V
overview.en: Weight g: 40g; Rated Power V: 24 V; Rated Torque N·m: 0.076 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 0.23 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 4110 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 24 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI50 KV100 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI50 KV100 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage（V）：24/36/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque（Nm）：0.58 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed（rpm）：1090/1860/2600 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque（Nm）：1.67 Nm；质量 · Weight（g）：180.8 g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24/36/48 V
overview.en: Rated Voltage（V）: 24/36/48 V; Rated Torque（Nm）: 0.58 Nm; Rated Speed（rpm）: 1090/1860/2600 rpm; Peak Torque（Nm）: 1.67 Nm; Weight（g）: 180.8 g; Rated Voltage (V): 24/36/48 V

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.en: RI60 KV120 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage（V）：24/36/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque（Nm）：0.57 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed（rpm）：1440/2320/3190 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque（Nm）：1.63 Nm；质量 · Weight（g）：155.9 g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24/36/48 V
overview.en: Rated Voltage（V）: 24/36/48 V; Rated Torque（Nm）: 0.57 Nm; Rated Speed（rpm）: 1440/2320/3190 rpm; Peak Torque（Nm）: 1.63 Nm; Weight（g）: 155.9 g; Rated Voltage (V): 24/36/48 V

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI70 KV95 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI70 KV95 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage（V）：24/36/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque（Nm）：0.94 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed（rpm）：1270/1990/2710 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque（Nm）：2.68 Nm；质量 · Weight（g）：270.4 g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24/36/48 V
overview.en: Rated Voltage（V）: 24/36/48 V; Rated Torque（Nm）: 0.94 Nm; Rated Speed（rpm）: 1270/1990/2710 rpm; Peak Torque（Nm）: 2.68 Nm; Weight（g）: 270.4 g; Rated Voltage (V): 24/36/48 V

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI75-PH KV70 Welded Model 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI75-PH KV70 Welded Model is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：348 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：1.2 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：3.8 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：2365 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 348 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 1.2 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 3.8 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 2365 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI75-PH KV70 With Connector 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI75-PH KV70 With Connector is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：348 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：1.2 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：3.8 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：2365 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 348 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 1.2 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 3.8 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 2365 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI80 V2.0 KV75 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI80 V2.0 KV75 is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 额定电压 · Rated Voltage（V）：24/36/48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque（Nm）：1.45 Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed（rpm）：1135/1785/2430 rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque（Nm）：4.1 Nm；质量 · Weight（g）：411 g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24/36/48 V
overview.en: Rated Voltage（V）: 24/36/48 V; Rated Torque（Nm）: 1.45 Nm; Rated Speed（rpm）: 1135/1785/2430 rpm; Peak Torque（Nm）: 4.1 Nm; Weight（g）: 411 g; Rated Voltage (V): 24/36/48 V

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI85-PH KV85 Welded Model 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI85-PH KV85 Welded Model is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：411 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：2 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：5 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：3042 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 411 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 2 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 5 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 3042 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RI85-PH KV85 With Connector 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RI85-PH KV85 With Connector is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：411 g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：48 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：2 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：5 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：3042 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：48 V
overview.en: Weight g: 411 g; Rated Power V: 48 V; Rated Torque N·m: 2 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 5 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 3042 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 48 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RO100 KV55-Standard-with-hall 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO100 KV55-Standard-with-hall is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: RO40 KV140 Lite 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO40 KV140 Lite is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: RO50 KV108 Lite 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO50 KV108 Lite is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight g：105g；额定功率 · Rated Power V：24 V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque N·m：0.3 N·m；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque N·m：0.9 N·m；额定转速 · Rated Speed RPM：2100 RPM；额定电压 · Rated Voltage (V)：24 V
overview.en: Weight g: 105g; Rated Power V: 24 V; Rated Torque N·m: 0.3 N·m; Peak Torque N·m: 0.9 N·m; Rated Speed RPM: 2100 RPM; Rated Voltage (V): 24 V

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RO60 KV115 Lite without hall 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO60 KV115 Lite without hall is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RO60 KV115-Standard-with-hall 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO60 KV115-Standard-with-hall is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight：248g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage：48V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque：0.8Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed：4200rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque：2.4Nm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：352 W
overview.en: Weight: 248g; Rated Voltage: 48V; Rated Torque: 0.8Nm; Rated Speed: 4200rpm; Peak Torque: 2.4Nm; Rated Power (W): 352 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RO80 KV105 Lite without hall 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO80 KV105 Lite without hall is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight：265g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage：48V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque：1.3Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed：3600rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque：4Nm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：490 W
overview.en: Weight: 265g; Rated Voltage: 48V; Rated Torque: 1.3Nm; Rated Speed: 3600rpm; Peak Torque: 4Nm; Rated Power (W): 490 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: RO80 KV105-Standard-with-hall 是用于机器人机构集成的无框力矩电机，定子和转子安装到应用机构中输出转矩。霍尔反馈、灌封和连接器配置仅按该型号官方选项。
overview.en: RO80 KV105-Standard-with-hall is a frameless torque motor whose stator and rotor integrate into the robot mechanism. Hall feedback, potting and connector configuration follow the model-specific official option.

overview.zh: 质量 · Weight：352g；额定电压 · Rated Voltage：48V；额定扭矩 · Rated Torque：1.3Nm；额定转速 · Rated Speed：3600rpm；峰值扭矩 · Peak Torque：4Nm；额定功率 · Rated Power (W)：490 W
overview.en: Weight: 352g; Rated Voltage: 48V; Rated Torque: 1.3Nm; Rated Speed: 3600rpm; Peak Torque: 4Nm; Rated Power (W): 490 W

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: TW-40A-12S（2pcs/set） 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。

overview.zh: 外形尺寸 · Dimensions：78 × 30 × 19.9 mm；质量 · Weight (per unit)：90.33 g；通信接口 · Communication mode：Serial

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: TW-80A-12S（2pcs/set） 为匹配无刷电机提供电子换相、功率驱动和所列控制接口。驱动器限流是电子部件能力，不等于配套电机的连续转矩。
overview.en: TW-80A-12S（2pcs/set） provides commutation, power-stage drive and the listed control interfaces for compatible brushless motors. Drive current limits describe electronics, not the matched motor's continuous torque.

overview.zh: 外形尺寸 · Dimensions：83 × 35 × 22.8 mm；质量 · Weight (per unit)：149.33 g；通信接口 · Communication mode：Serial
overview.en: Dimensions: 83 × 35 × 22.8 mm; Weight (per unit): 149.33 g; Communication mode: Serial

applications.zh: 机器人与机电系统集成；适配范围以型号及配套件表为准
applications.en: Robotic and electromechanical integration, subject to the model and accessory compatibility table

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

overview.zh: AK70-9 KV60 将无刷电机、9:1 行星减速器和双编码器集成到机器人关节模块，网页提供带/不带驱动板选项。该未标代际页面与独立 V3.0 页面分别保留，因编码器和外形尺寸描述不同。
overview.en: AK70-9 KV60 combines a brushless motor, 9:1 planetary reducer and dual feedback in a robotic joint module, with a driver-board selection on the page. This unversioned page is retained separately from the V3.0 page because encoder and dimensional descriptions differ.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、绕组和接头配置核对驱动器及线束。额定值、峰值和不同工作点分别保留；电机本体数据不代表整机末端性能。
integration.en: Check drive and harness compatibility against the model, generation, winding and connector configuration. Rated values, peaks and operating points remain distinct; motor specifications do not establish complete-machine end-effector performance.

verification.zh: 选型判断：核对实际电压下的转速与扭矩、峰值持续时间、散热边界和反馈接口。网页未给出的工程图公差及寿命，不作为已满足要求。
verification.en: Selection assessment: check speed and torque at the actual supply voltage, peak duration, thermal limits and feedback interfaces. Unpublished drawing tolerances and service life are not treated as satisfied requirements.

V2.0 specifications and V1.0 manual have different instantaneous-duration conditions. The V1.0 manual reverses its forward/reverse descriptions between pages 1 and 3. Ratings, duty and polarity remain conditional.

Current model-page tables and the added driver/ESC manual tables are indexed. Other linked CAD drawing dimensions, GL-II quick-guide pin images and every protocol packet/register are not all structured. current-catalog-difference.json lists each PDF, its text availability and row-reference count; lack of text is not called lack of public access.

conflicts.detail: TW-80A-12S V2.0 specification publishes 40 A continuous / 90 A instantaneous under heat dissipation, with instantaneous duration <10 s; the product name is not the continuous rating.
TW-40A-12S V2.0 specification publishes 25 A continuous / 45 A instantaneous under heat dissipation, with instantaneous duration <10 s; the product name is not the continuous rating.
Installation manual p8 assigns power pin 1 negative/red and pin 2 positive/black, unlike normal power-wire convention; retain source conflict and do not infer correct polarity.
The V1.0 manual p1 calls PWM 1000-1500 us forward, while p3 calls 1500-2000 us forward. Neutral is 1500 us; rotation direction cannot be selected from these conflicting descriptions alone.
